rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever it fires a shot of any power, there must be a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and the gun must be pointing at it within 3.0°; with no target or a stale scan, it never fires.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever it drives forward, the distance driven must leave at least 80 pixels of the free space ahead, and whenever it drives backward, the distance driven must leave at least 80 pixels of the free space behind; if it doesn't drive at all, this says nothing.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved both rules: S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn, with the gun aimed at it) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). Neither battle, open arena or city map, showed any violations, which fits the proofs.
